services.desc: We are a family owned and operated mobile jet ski rental business serving the Orlando and Central Florida surrounding areas where we bring the watercraft to you. Randy is from the U.S. Virgin Islands - St. Croix where he grew up along the beautiful beaches and crystal clear water of the Caribbean all while Katie grew up in the Midwest specifically Illinois where she enjoyed boating on the lake with her family. We both met in Orlando, FL and that is where our journey began together. Therefore, we created Island Vibez Watersport Rentals so we can share our love and passion for adventure and the water with you.
